It narrows the usual CV/NLP interview material toward robotics-specific issues, making it useful as a focused roadmap for people preparing to work on embodied AI systems.

title: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground
summary: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground is an open-source library for training robot policies with GPU-accelerated MuJoCo simulations and carrying them toward real-world deployment. It is aimed at sim-to-real workflows, giving researchers a practical playground for running fast robot learning experiments rather than building the simulation and training infrastructure from scratch.

extra.full_text: An open-source library for GPU-accelerated robot learning and sim-to-real transfer.

title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
summary: PACE is a sim-to-real pipeline for legged robots that focuses on identifying actuator and joint dynamics using only standard joint encoder readings, rather than extra sensing hardware. The repo appears aimed at making simulated policies transfer more reliably to real robots by systematically fitting the low-level dynamics that often cause reality gaps in locomotion.

extra.full_text: PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation and geometry code that can plug into robotics and machine learning workflows. It is especially useful when researchers need fast differentiable physics, particle or rigid-body simulation, collision queries, or custom CUDA-like kernels from Python without dropping fully into low-level GPU programming.

extra.full_text: A Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, robotics, and machine learning.

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack provides a compact sim-to-real stack for training and deploying VLA models and reinforcement-learning agents without depending on ROS. It wraps MuJoCo environments in Gymnasium with synchronous execution and supports common robot platforms including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for teams that want a lighter-weight path from simulation experiments to real robot control.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101 and YAM.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: Isaac Lab - Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable system for building robotics simulation environments from interchangeable robot embodiments, objects, and task settings. It is aimed at quickly prototyping robot-learning tasks and evaluating policies across diverse simulated setups, making it useful for scaling experiments beyond a single fixed environment.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: iit-DLSLab/sim2real-robot-identification
summary: Provides a joint calibration routine for quadrupeds and manipulators aimed at reducing the mismatch between simulated and physical robots. It is meant to support sim-to-real transfer for policies or models developed in IsaacLab and MuJoCo, giving researchers a practical way to align joint behavior before deploying on real hardware.

extra.full_text: A joints calibration routine for quadrupeds and manipulators to facilitate sim-to-real transfer from isaaclab and mujoco to real robots

title: iit-DLSLab/basic-locomotion-isaaclab
summary: IsaacLab DirectEnv implementation for training basic quadrupedal locomotion policies across multiple robot platforms. It is aimed at practical transfer workflows, with support for sim-to-sim evaluation and sim-to-real deployment pipelines rather than just a single simulated robot setup.

extra.full_text: An IsaacLab DirectEnv for basic quadrupedal locomotion tasks, with support for multiple quadruped robots, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real pipelines

title: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab
summary: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab collects tutorials for training robot policies with reinforcement learning and imitation learning on ROBOTIS platforms. Its practical focus is Sim2Real: helping users move learned policies from simulation onto physical ROBOTIS robots, making it useful as a hands-on starting point for researchers or engineers testing learning-based control on real hardware.

extra.full_text: This repository provides tutorials for reinforcement learning and imitation learning using ROBOTIS robots, and supports Sim2Real functionality for deploying the learned policies on real robots.

title: scy-v/VLA-Precision
summary: VLA-Precision implements Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for making vision-language-action models more efficient at real-world online reinforcement learning. The idea appears to center on improving policy learning directly from robot interaction while reducing the practical cost of online RL, making it relevant for researchers trying to adapt VLA models beyond offline imitation into precise real-world manipulation.

extra.full_text: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models

title: RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse
summary: RoboVerse aims to unify the robot-learning pipeline around a shared platform, dataset, and benchmark for training and evaluating scalable, generalizable robot policies. It is positioned as infrastructure for researchers who need a common environment to compare methods across robot tasks and datasets rather than stitching together separate simulators, data formats, and evaluation setups.

extra.full_text: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning

title: dartsim/dart
summary: DART is a C++23 physics engine aimed at robotics, animation, and machine learning research, with Python bindings for experiment workflows. It is useful when researchers need simulation infrastructure for dynamics-heavy systems rather than a black-box application: the emphasis is on physically grounded modeling that can plug into robotics and learning pipelines.

extra.full_text: Research-focused C++23 physics engine for robotics, animation, and machine learning, with Python bindings

title: facebookresearch/project_superdex
summary: SuperDex is a unified robotics simulation platform from facebookresearch that combines a purpose-built physics engine, robotics authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement-learning interface. It is aimed at building and training dexterous robot behaviors in simulation, with VR-based teleoperation already part of the system and more capabilities planned for later releases.

extra.full_text: SuperDex brings together a purpose-built physics engine, robotics authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement learning interface in a unified simulation platform, with VR-based teleoperation and additional capabilities planned for future releases.

title: abmoRobotics/RLRoverLab
summary: RLRoverLab provides rover and space-focused reinforcement learning environments built on Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab. It is useful as a simulation testbed for training and evaluating embodied RL policies in planetary-rover-style settings, especially where researchers want physics-based environments aligned with NVIDIA’s robotics tooling.

extra.full_text: Rover and space-related reinforcement learning environments implemented for Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab.

title: castacks/AirStack
summary: AirStack is an agent-native robotics framework aimed at moving embodied AI from simulation to field hardware quickly, using a closed-loop workflow that mirrors the real robot one-to-one. It emphasizes self-validation and rapid sim-to-real iteration, making it useful for teams deploying field robotics systems where autonomy code needs to be tested against hardware-facing constraints rather than only offline simulation.

extra.full_text: Agent-native framework for rapid sim-to-real deployment of embodied AI for field robotics. Closed-loop, one-to-one workflow with hardware, self validating. Checkout develop branch for latest features.

title: iit-DLSLab/get-up-isaaclab
summary: An IsaacLab DirectEnv implementation for training quadruped robots to recover from the ground into a standing posture. It is set up to work across multiple quadruped platforms and includes paths for sim-to-sim validation and sim-to-real transfer, making it useful for researchers testing get-up policies before deployment.

title: kuds/mesozoic-labs
summary: mesozoic-labs is an open-source platform for studying dinosaur biomechanics through MuJoCo/Gymnasium locomotion environments trained with reinforcement learning. It packages curriculum learning and W&B experiment tracking around simulated dinosaur-inspired robots, with an explicit aim of using the learned controllers and morphologies for sim-to-real transfer in physical robotic locomotion.

extra.full_text: Open-source research platform for dinosaur biomechanics and robotic locomotion using reinforcement learning. MuJoCo-based Gymnasium environments with curriculum learning, W&B experiment tracking, and sim-to-real transfer goals.

title: EGalahad/mimic-lite
summary: mimic-lite targets efficient whole-body motion tracking for humanoid robots, with an emphasis on scaling up training and making the learned behavior usable in sim-to-real deployment. The repository appears focused on a lightweight pipeline for training humanoids to reproduce reference motions across the full body, useful when researchers need motion-tracking policies that are fast enough to iterate on and practical enough to transfer beyond simulation.

title: chang-xinhai/Awesome-Dexterous-Manipulation
summary: chang-xinhai/Awesome-Dexterous-Manipulation is a curated index of resources around dexterous robot manipulation, spanning tactile sensing, dexterous hands, robot learning, datasets, benchmarks, and simulators. It is useful as a map of the field for quickly finding papers, tools, evaluation setups, and related infrastructure when working on manipulation with multi-fingered robotic hands.

extra.full_text: A curated awesome list for dexterous robot manipulation, tactile sensing, dexterous hands, robot learning, datasets, benchmarks, and simulators.

title: JaimeParker/rl-garden
summary: rl-garden is a PyTorch-native, GPU-first framework for robot learning that brings reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and diffusion/flow policy methods into one toolkit. It includes more than 55 algorithms plus sim-to-real backends, making it useful for researchers who want to prototype and compare robot-learning approaches without stitching together separate training stacks.

extra.full_text: PyTorch-native, GPU-first robot-learning framework — RL, imitation learning, and diffusion/flow policies, 55+ algorithms, sim-to-real backends.

title: limxdynamics/limxsdk-lowlevel
summary: limxsdk-lowlevel provides dependency-free C++11 and Python bindings for sending low-level motion-control commands to LimX robots across Linux x86_64/aarch64 and Windows. It is aimed at robotics developers who need a lightweight control interface that can plug into ROS/Gazebo workflows and support reinforcement-learning sim-to-real deployment without pulling in a large runtime stack.

extra.full_text: Dependency-free C++11 & Python SDK for low-level motion control of LimX robots — cross-platform (Linux x86_64/aarch64, Windows), integrates with ROS/Gazebo and RL-based sim-to-real deployment.

title: maniparena/maniparena-sim
summary: ManipArena-Sim provides the Isaac Lab-based simulation stack behind ManipArena, a real-robot benchmark for bimanual manipulation. It is built for collecting data, replaying trajectories, and evaluating policies for a bimanual robot, making it useful for testing manipulation methods in simulation before or alongside real-robot benchmark runs.

extra.full_text: ManipArena-Sim is the simulation environment for ManipArena, a real-robot benchmark for bimanual manipulation. It provides data collection, replay, and policy evaluation for the bimanual robot, built on Isaac Lab and IsaacLab-Arena.
